header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

The Marriage of Hadhrat Rabee'ah Aslami (RA)

Hadhrat Rabee'ah (RA) says, "I was Rasulullaah ﷺ's servant. One day he asked, 'O Rabee'ah! Are you not interested in getting married?' I replied, 'I have no intention of marrying. While I have nothing with which to support a wife, I also do not want anything to preoccupy me from (serving) you.' When Rasulullaah ﷺ turned away from me, I said to myself, 'By Allaah! Rasulullaah ﷺ definitely knows better than me what is best for me in this world and in the Aakhirah. By Allaah! Should he ever again ask me whether I am interested in getting married, I shall reply, 'Certainly, O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Instruct me as you please.' When Rasulullaah ﷺ did ask me whether I was interested in getting married, I replied, 'Certainly, O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Instruct me as you please.' Rasulullaah ﷺ then instructed me to go to a particular tribe of the Ansaar who did not frequently meet with Rasulullaah ﷺ. He told me to tell them that he had sent me to them with instructions to get me married to a certain girl from amongst them. I therefore went to them and informed them that Rasulullaah ﷺ had sent me with instructions that they get me married. 'Welcome to Rasulullaah ﷺ and the messenger of Rasulullaah ﷺ!' they cried out, 'By Allaah! the messenger of Rasulullaah ﷺ shall never return without having his need fulfilled. They then got me married and treated me exceptionally well without even asking for a witness.

I returned depressed to Rasulullaah ﷺ saying, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I have been to people who are extremely generous. They got me married and treated me exceptionally well without even asking for a witness. However, I have no dowry to give. Rasulullaah ﷺ then called for Buraydah Aslami (RA) (the leader of my tribe) and instructed him to collect some gold for me equivalent to the weight of a date stone. When I took possession of what the people collected for me, I brought it to Rasulullaah ﷺ who said, 'Take this to them and tell them that this is her dowry.' When I did so and told them that this was her dowry, they accepted it with great happiness and said, 'This is excellent and so much!'

When I again returned depressed to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he asked, 'Why so gloomy, O Rabee'ah?' 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ!' I began, 'I have never met people as wonderful as them. They were happy with what I gave them and treated me extremely well. They even told me that the dowry was excellent and so much.' However, I have nothing with which to host a Waleemah. 'O Buraydah!' Rasulullaah ﷺ called out, 'Collect (money) for a goat for him.' After the people (of my tribe) had collected (enough to buy) a large and fat sheep, Rasulullaah ﷺ instructed me to go to Aa'isha (RA) and tell her to give me the basket containing the grains. I did as I was ordered and she said, 'Here is the basket containing seven Saa of barley. By Allaah! By Allaah! we have no other food besides this. You may have it.'
